<div class="card-body">
'''Self-Destruct Mechanism''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">自爆装置</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：ドロイドを1体犠牲（没収）にすることで、このターンの同じ位置でのすべての損耗をキャンセルする。2：相手の武器の目標を、同じ位置にいる自分のドロイドの1体に変更する。ドロイドがロストした場合には、もとの目標の没収値を適用する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Self-Destruct-Mechanism-PSA-88099881.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「きれいに吹っ飛んじまったぜ……俺の撃ったのが致命傷だったとは思えん。自爆装置が付いてたみたいだな」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Self-Destruct Mechanism.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Sacrifice (forfeit) one droid to cancel all attrition at the same location this turn. Change an opponent's weapon target to one of your droids at the same location. If the droid is lost, apply the original target's forfeit value.

'''Lore:'''
It blew apart cleanly... I don't think my shot was a fatal wound. Looks like it had a self-destruct device attached.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Numbered modes 1 and 2 replace the English OR.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Self-Destruct Mechanism]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
